status: audit complete; multi-world action-label experiment not yet run
finding: The counterfactual collector replays candidate actions from a captured real battle snapshot. Policy features are player-view observations, but outcome labels are conditioned on that match's actual hidden opponent sets.
public_compatible_search_path: The midgame search path samples hidden teams from public preview species and revealed facts, then builds sanitized current-state snapshots. Its current set prior comes from Showdown's random-champions set builder and does not cover all plausible legal tournament sets.
implication: Actual-hidden-set labels can yield action rankings that transfer poorly when the hidden-team distribution changes. Max Damage remains a regression opponent, but its win rate alone is not a general-strength measure.
next_gate: Train action values over multiple independently sampled public-compatible hidden worlds per public state, with paired chance seeds, and compare against the incumbent on held-out teams/worlds and the full opponent league.
